findings.evidence: "The employee receives a confirmation email once processing finishes. Then, the employee reviews the confirmation summary before submitting the final request."
findings.fix: Clarify the actual sequence and rewrite to ensure the review and submission step occurs either before or after final processing, but not both.
findings.location: How to Apply section, third and fourth sentences
findings.violation: The sequence is logically contradictory - the employee cannot review and submit before final processing if the confirmation arrives after processing finishes.

findings.evidence: "You must keep your equipment in good working condition and we may ask for a brief photo check once a year."
findings.fix: Rewrite in third person: "Employees must keep equipment in good working condition, and the company may request a brief photo check once a year."
findings.location: Restrictions and Exceptions section, first sentence
findings.violation: Shifts from third-person point of view used throughout the document to second person ("you") and first person plural ("we").

findings.evidence: "Also, you submit the request in the portal. Countersign the employee request within two business days. You track its status there until the payment clears."
findings.fix: Replace ambiguous pronouns with specific roles: "Employees submit the request in the portal. Managers countersign the employee request within two business days. Employees track its status there until the payment clears."
findings.violation: The pronoun "you" has an ambiguous referent, and "Countersign" lacks a subject, leaving unclear who performs each action.

findings.evidence: "A separate audit last spring reviewed unrelated travel expenses. Federal guidance on remote work continues to evolve each year. The office coffee budget was reset at the start of the quarter."
findings.violation: These sentences about travel expenses, federal guidance, and office coffee are not relevant to the home office equipment stipend policy.

findings.evidence: "Completing the request begins with confirming eligibility, and the uploaded receipt."
findings.fix: Rewrite as "Completing the request begins with confirming eligibility and uploading a receipt."
findings.violation: Incomplete parallel construction - "the uploaded receipt" is not a step parallel to "confirming eligibility."

findings.evidence: "Every entry carries a date stamp so the record stays easy to audit."
findings.fix: Remove this duplicate sentence from Special Cases.
findings.location: Special Cases section, final two sentences
findings.violation: This sentence is duplicated verbatim from the Program Overview section.
